plan.rationale: Router authorized merging K7_C0002 and K7_C0003. The union eigengap is single-cluster dominated (candidate_k=1; leading gap 0.549), which is merge-compatible, and the native-view separation is weak across all four modalities (CT 0.061, RNA 0.078, WSI 0.129, WXS 0.046) with substantial negative fractions up to 0.417. Although the current boundary shows strong two-way spectral representation (ARI 1.0; within 0.396 vs between 0.176), the union is more consistent with a single unit, and the two sets share a reciprocal immune-inflammatory axis. K7_C0003 membership is additionally confounded by six significant technical/acquisition factors. This revision is provisional and returns to normal review.
